source.origin: Montage posted on Twitter/X by Ronak Malde (author of github.com/rmalde/minecraft-agent)
source.agent: GPT-6 Astra (planner) + typesafe JEV (action selection) on Mineflayer
source.method: Read the burned-in top banner ('ASTRA + JEV | elapsed | XYZ', Astra objective) from frames sampled at 2 fps. The montage cuts footage, but the banner shows true elapsed run time, so each milestone is bracketed between the last frame before it and the first frame after it.
caveats: Montage: the gameplay between cuts is not visible, so waste inside a cut can't be diagnosed from video alone; only the brackets and Astra objectives can.
The banner shows COMPLETE at about 08:36.7, but the title and README say 8:43.300. The 6.6 s gap is unexplained (possibly a different timer start or end event). Ask the author or report both.
This is the author's published run, not a first attempt we ran. Exact prompts are not available; label it as published context.
